title: Great Photography Class!
text: The photography session was inspiring and very enjoyable. The teacher was knowledgeable, patient, and made everything easy to understand.
author: Vanessa_M

title: What fun!
text:
I had such a great experience learning new ways to use the camera in my phone. It’s made me love doing photography again! 

I also appreciated the location that was chosen at Parc Cuitadell, where there was plenty of shade to stay cool and review the photos. 

Highly recommend for photographers of any level!
author: F1916NNteresab

title: Relaxed and super informative iPhone photography course
text: We had a great photography session with Onno. The pace was relaxed over the space of 2&1/2 hours. Onno showed us some great tips on our iPhone and how to make the most of our travel photography. Thoroughly recommended for a different practical session on iPhone photography in the old town of Barcelona.
author: Coastal42402552144

title: Amazing class!
text: Great class/tour! Lots of amazing tips and tricks for taking photos while also showing us some of the city. Thanks for a great time!
author: ehia2025

title: Super insightful!
text: Super useful tips, doesn't matter if you don't have the latest phone. You can still learn the tricks to take amazing photos! Even emailed a document afterwards which is so thoughtful!
author: 84neshat

title: Great tour
text: The activity was great. Onno taught us some cool tricks and helped us take better photos and we also got some awesome pics. He was also chilled that we brought our baby with us!
author: Tammy4567

title: Knowledgeable guide
text:
Onno was very knowledgeable and shared his experience/ expertise with us.  We came away with some new techniques to practice and improve upon going forward.
We would recommend others to take this tour for some exceptional photos. 
Thanks again Isabel and Pam from Canada
author: Isabel T

title: Nice walk and nice photos
text: My husband and I have been to Barcelona already a few times, so we decided to take some untraditional tour this time. This tour caught our eye because, as people who travel a lot, we are always trying to capture the moment, but it doesn't always look well:) This tour was very insightful; we learned some interesting tricks and used them several times afterward. It also takes place in a fantastic part of Barcelona, so the walk is delightful. I would recommend this tour ☺️
author: alinaaC920KC

title: iPhone photography tips
text: Onno’s iPhone photography tips were really helpful. I learned several things that will improve my pictures. Thanks for the tour!
